channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Oilers' Resilience Finally Shakes Off A Concerning Trend This Season
item.description: It may have taken until Jan. 29 to get their third win in a row in 2025-26, but the Edmonton Oilers showed once again that they remain a very hard team to put away.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Rangers' Artemi Panarin Prepares To Move On, Plus The Latest Blue Jackets Buzz
item.description: Potential trade candidates are emerging for New York Rangers winger Artemi Panarin, while the Columbus Blue Jackets are still determining whether to be sellers in the trade market.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: What Trades Could The Hurricanes And Stars Make?
item.description: Katie Gaus, Ryan Kennedy and Michael Traikos discuss the Sharks, Panarin, Stars, Hurricanes, Capitals, the NHL draft and more.

item.title: Blackhawks Should Be Buyers At 2026 NHL Trade Deadline
item.description: The Chicago Blackhawks might not have a playoff spot right now, but they should still be open to being buyers at the 2026 NHL trade deadline.

item.title: 'If We Don't Do This, Who Will?': Former Pro Hockey Player Oleksiy Lazarenko Fights For Ukraine
item.description: Oleksiy Lazarenko was not in the military. He was a hockey player and coach. The game was his life. But when Russia invaded Ukraine, he knew what he had to do. - By Jared Clinton

item.title: Is Brandon Bussi The Carolina Hurricanes' New Cam Ward?
item.description: The 27-year-old goalie became the fastest NHLer to record 20 career wins, surpassing Andrew Hammond of the Ottawa Senators and Bill Durnan of the Montreal Canadiens.

item.title: 2026 NHL Draft Rankings: Ryan Kennedy's Mid-Season Top 32
item.description: With a cluster of four players at the top of the NHL draft class, prospect expert Ryan Kennedy's mid-season rankings feature a new No. 1.

item.title: Macklin Celebrini Plays Hockey The Right Way. Be Like Macklin Celebrini
item.description: After trying to wave off a high-sticking penalty against the Edmonton Oilers, everyone should play the game like San Jose Sharks sophomore Macklin Celebrini.

item.title: Getting To Know The Real Tom Wilson: Capitals Star Reflects On Evolution & Winding Road To Olympics
item.description: Washington Capitals right winger Tom Wilson is one of the NHL's top power forwards and most fascinating characters. He knew what he had to do to make The Show — and when he had to change.

item.title: Maple Leafs Not Only Need To Keep Scott Laughton, They Must Use Him Better
item.description: Toronto Maple Leafs center Scott Laughton is a pending UFA. But instead of trading him, the Leafs should keep him for the long term. And they need to play him more.
